name: Mozzarella (Low-Moisture)

low.description: About 1/3 cup shredded or 1.5 oz slice

siboNotes: Aged and low-moisture cheeses like mozzarella are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. The aging process reduces lactose content significantly.
preparationTips: Choose block mozzarella and shred yourself for better texture and fewer additives
Low-moisture mozzarella melts well without becoming watery
Store properly wrapped in refrigerator to prevent drying out
Can be frozen for up to 6 months, though texture may change slightly
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
